name: 1054 Pentair FRP Vessel
summary: The Pentair 1054 FRP Pressure Vessel is a premium-quality 10" × 54" top-open fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) vessel designed for water softening, filtration, and industrial water treatment applications.
intro: The Pentair 1054 FRP Pressure Vessel is a premium-quality 10" × 54" top-open fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) vessel designed for water softening, filtration, and industrial water treatment applications. With a 62-litre media capacity, 150 PSI pressure rating, corrosion-resistant FRP construction, and durable blue finish, it delivers reliable performance, long service life, and excellent resistance to rust and chemicals. Suitable for residential, commercial, and industrial water treatment systems.
